storage: Keep unwashed in a paper towel or cloth inside a bag or box in the fridge for 3–4 days; remove any yellow leaves first. Picked, washed and fully dried leaves keep 2–3 days in a box lined with paper towel. Chopped leaves can be frozen for a few weeks for theplas and parathas (texture softens).
looksLike: Small, oval, flat, bright-green leaves in groups of three on thin, pale stems, sold tied in bunches (judi) with the roots or lower stems on. It has a slightly bitter, grassy smell.
shelfLife: 1–2 days at room temperature; 3–4 days in the fridge.

usedIn.raw: 30 g picked leaves, chopped (from about 60–70 g of a bunch with stems)
